prompt: Leave the voicemail Dad leaves after hearing about your promotion. He is very proud. He will not say that.
response:
Hey, it’s Dad.

Your mom told me about the promotion. That’s good. Real good.

I always figured they’d catch on eventually, if they had any sense over there. Sounds like they finally did.

Anyway, I was thinking—if they’re giving you more responsibility, make sure you get the title in writing and not just the extra work. People will pat you on the back all day if it saves them money.

But… yeah. That’s something. You earned it.

We’ll do dinner this weekend if you’re free. Pick somewhere decent, not one of those places with the tiny chairs.

Alright. Call me when you get a chance.

And hey—nice job.
